query: SELECT c.id, c.companyName, c.activityLevel, COUNT(tx.id) AS tx_count, COALESCE(SUM(tx.amount),0) AS revenue FROM clients c LEFT JOIN transactions tx ON tx.clientId = c.id WHERE LOWER(c.companyName) LIKE '%khan%' GROUP BY c.id, c.companyName, c.activityLevel;
